mode_help: ide: an agent in an IDE chat with the model built in (no API key) runs one card per chat through handover/ide.ps1. loop: run-loop.ps1 starts the CLI harness below for every card and needs that harness's API key (for claude-code: DEEPSEEK_API_KEY).

claude-code.description: Claude Code CLI pointed at DeepSeek's Anthropic-compatible endpoint (settings from api-docs.deepseek.com). The card arrives on stdin; rules + contracts are appended to the system prompt so they form a stable cached prefix.
args: Execute the handover card provided on stdin. Follow the executor rules in your system prompt exactly.

Read,Edit,Write,Glob,Grep,Bash(powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File handover/verify.ps1 *),Bash(powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ./handover/verify.ps1 *),Bash(pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File handover/verify.ps1 *),Bash(git status *),Bash(git diff *)
Bash(git commit *),Bash(git push *),Bash(git reset *),Bash(git checkout *),Bash(git stash *),Bash(git clean *),Bash(git restore *),WebFetch,WebSearch

codex.description: Codex CLI configured for DeepSeek with DeepSeek's setup script (api-docs.deepseek.com, Codex integration). Flags vary by Codex version: confirm with 'codex exec --help' and edit these args.
args: Read handover/.run/PREFIX.md (your rules and the project contracts). Then read the card in {PROMPT_FILE} and execute it exactly.
